metadata.description: Plugins for AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, and any Agent Skills host.

plugins.name: pr-comment
plugins.description: A tool that analyzes and categorizes all comments on GitHub PRs. Organizes unresolved comments by priority for easy review.

plugins.name: skillify
plugins.description: Turns a validated solution or a recurring failure into a permanent skill with scripts, tests, evals, and a deterministic validation gate.

plugins.name: explain-ladder
plugins.description: Re-explains a topic in a new form when the user still does not understand: STE prose, then an ASCII diagram, then a step-by-step HTML page (2D, or a 3D scene for topics with depth), then a narrated video.

plugins.name: jev-delegation
plugins.description: Hands narrow judgments to TypeSafe's Jev model through the jev CLI, and says which Jev verdicts to act on and which only advise.
